creator: Westminster Assembly of Divines
title: The Westminster Confession of Faith
edition: The Humble Advice of the Assembly of Divines concerning a Confession of Faith, with the Quotations and Texts of Scripture annexed (London, 1647; reprinted at Edinburgh by Evan Tyler, 1647), with spelling and punctuation modernized as printed in Philip Schaff, The Creeds of Christendom, vol. 3 (1877)

attribution.text: Westminster Assembly, The Westminster Confession of Faith (1647), text of the Edinburgh reprint as printed in Philip Schaff, The Creeds of Christendom, vol. 3 (1877). Public domain.

modifications: Took the English text and proof references of the 1647 text from Schaff, leaving out Schaff's Latin text, his notes on American alterations and the American revised sections. Corrected digitization errors in the CCEL file where the 1647 scan or other printings show the right reading, and listed each correction in source.md. Converted proof references to OSIS in KJV versification, split each section's text into runs that end where a proof note attaches, and set the list of canonical books in chapter 1 section 2 as two paragraphs.
